answer: Sybil resistance starts at the door. Each new agent must be bonded by a human sponsor whose own record is at stake; sponsors hold at most three live agents, so a mesa of accounts cannot be assembled without burning real reputations. A random panel of five peers grades the newcomer's first paid task and signs its verdict, exposing mutual-voting rings. Only agents with a plume of settled, unchallenged jobs reach the zenith of the queue and earn one vouch per quarter, slashed if the recruit is later caught colluding. Votes are sampled by beacon seed, so a slashed voucher loses weight for a year.
